negative_findings.description: The cell brief lists 'Bankovnictví.cz' and 'Zdroj' as outlets. Searching in Czech resolved the banking magazine to bankovnictvionline.cz (Časopis Bankovnictví), not a 'bankovnictvi.cz' news site; no Czech banking/fintech outlet named 'Zdroj' was found — the closest fit is ČTK's wire/Protext, which is how agency-sourced ('zdroj: ČTK') items are credited in Czech media.
negative_findings.result_summary: Seed names corrected: Bankovnictví -> bankovnictvionline.cz; 'Zdroj/ČTK' -> ctk.cz / protext.cz / ib.ctk.cz.
negative_findings.why_it_matters: Prevents the pipeline from targeting a non-existent domain and mis-attributing agency copy.

negative_findings.description: Czech query combining Investičníweb + Podnikatel.cz with bank/fintech partnership terms returned no relevant articles from either outlet; results were dominated by Roklen24 and generic finance portals.

brief: Czech trade-media coverage of banking technology splits into three usable layers: consumer/business dailies (Lupa.cz, Měšec.cz, Peníze.cz, CzechCrunch, E15, HN, Euro.cz) that report launches and competitive positioning, a sector/enterprise-IT layer (Časopis Bankovnictví via bankovnictvionline.cz, SystemOnline.cz, Computerworld.cz case studies, CIOtrends' annual Případová studie archive, ITBiz.cz) that actually names suppliers and systems, and a wire/aggregation layer (ČTK Protext and Infobanka, CIA News, Kurzy.cz, Právě dnes, Médium.cz) that both originates vendor announcements and preserves them. The richest vendor-to-bank mapping evidence sits in the middle layer and in Protext sender indexes, which are open, while the two highest-credibility sources — HN.cz and ČTK Infobanka — are commercially gated and should be budgeted for rather than scraped. English trade press (FinTech Futures, The Fintech Times) reliably names vendors in CZ bank selections and is best used as a corroboration and discovery loop feeding Czech-language searches. Main outstanding weaknesses are an unexercised vendor-switch/failure vocabulary, no systematic per-actor name sweep, and no Slovak-language coverage of shared CZ/SK banking groups.
